_note: A measurement, never an authorisation. Page counts for every real-producer expansion fixture, converted once per document at the default product profile (pdfium backend, standard output profile, libreoffice oracle, refine3, 240dpi) inside the canonical gate container, then rendered once more with a dedicated soffice profile and counted with PyMuPDF. These numbers feed the by-engine support matrix (docs/diagrams/support-by-engine.svg) and the README's engine rows; they do not gate anything and no policy pins them. Comparison against the 2026-08 first measurements (docs/corpus-expansion.md sections 8-10) is informative, not a verdict: the converter moved between the two dates by design.
